# Fastener models

Screws, nuts and T-nuts from the [step.parts](https://www.step.parts) catalogue (downloaded 27 Oct 2026, sha256 checked
by the step.parts downloader), used by `cad/src/lib/robot_fasteners.py`. Screws: head bearing face at z = 0, shank
along -z (countersunk: head top at z = 0). Nuts and T-nuts: z 0 .. height. Heat-set inserts have no catalogue model and
are drawn as sleeves (M3 Ø4.5 x 4, M5 Ø7 x 8; measure the bought ones).
